name: Ján Vilček
narrative: Defected during a scientific conference. Co-developed Remicade (infliximab), one of the best-selling drugs in history. Donated $200M+ to NYU.

name: Peter Lowy
narrative: Family fled after 1968 Soviet invasion. Built Westfield Corporation into the world's largest shopping center company.

name: Ruzena Bajcsy
narrative: Left for Stanford, then became professor at UC Berkeley. Pioneer in computer vision and robotics. Member of the National Academy of Engineering.

name: Štefan Banič
narrative: Emigrated to the US and invented a parachute design in 1914, which he donated to the US Army.

name: Jozef Murgaš
narrative: Catholic priest who emigrated to Pennsylvania and pioneered wireless telegraphy. Held multiple patents predating some of Marconi's work.
